component.name: Spaced RGB
component.summary: Control RGB lighting and the Lian Li cooler display

description.p: Set colors, brightness and lighting effects across supported RAM, graphics cards and coolers. Save presets and select all devices together.
Display images or a large CPU temperature in Fahrenheit on the Lian Li Galahad II LCD. Hardware Enable opens authentication and refreshes device access without restarting the app.
Uses OpenRGB and liquidctl. Device support depends on their drivers; the Galahad II LCD integration targets USB device 0416:7395.
Initial release with RGB presets, device selection, Hardware Enable and Galahad II LCD temperature and image display.
